main_body: Flat sand ground patch (desert), 4x3 tiles of a repeating 16px pattern; not a standing object
top_band: none - terrain surface with no standing volume, so there is no top band or front face to read
evidence: This is a ground tile, not a standing object. It shows no front elevation, side face or top-down slab, so the 3/4 contract for standing objects does not apply and nothing in it breaks that contract.

style.evidence: The sand uses a tan base plus lighter and cream highlight specks, darker tan dune dashes and a few mid-brown dots. That gives about 5 lightness steps. There is no outline, which fits ground. Dots and short dune streaks are spread across every tile, so no 5x5 area is a flat fill. Each tile carries roughly 5-6 colours, a little below the reference tiles. The 16px pattern repeats identically and is noticeable, but the piece sits acceptably next to the grass and paving references.
